keypad.visualNotes: Function column at the left of the recessed key bank. ENT green; ESC and Toggle red. The face is a code-drawn style reference, not a manufacturer photograph.

verifiedNavigation.fact: Local numeric hotkey then ENT at each level; dotted addresses identify the path, not a single root shortcut.
Zone programming proceeds through four-digit zone selection, type, attribute list, ward mask and description. ENT accepts each stage; ESC returns.
Attribute digits 1–9 select the named attribute; the physical Toggle key changes Yes/No. Numeric ward keys toggle the ward mask.
Zone descriptions are 16 characters. The helper edits text; physical multi-tap timing and cursor behavior are not implemented.
M800 Omit Zones accepts a four-digit eligible zone, Toggle changes its omission, ENT advances and ESC exits. Ordinary omission is reinstated when the ward is unset.
View Zones and Zone Resistance are different routes. The latter is Engineer 2 → 7 Built In Tests → 3 Equipment → 4 Zone Resistance.
The dedicated resistance display shows ohms immediately. A healthy 4K7/2K2 FSL loop is 2.2 kΩ; active is 6.9 kΩ; an open panel input reads 11.463 kΩ.
Up selects earlier log events; Toggle displays associated text. # is not substituted for that control.
M750/M800 physical panel-output testing uses outputs 1, 3 and 4.
M800 Manager Edit Codes has 1 Code, 2 User Name, 3 Customise Menus and 4 Telecommands. Shunt, Set Only and Not in use have no user-type hotkey.

sourceDiscrepancies.resolution: Use the printed document identity and pin its hash.

sourceDiscrepancies.issue: The older Time Switch prose says up to three, but its diagram mentions keys 1–4.
sourceDiscrepancies.resolution: Three training records; discrepancy exposed as a gap.

sourceDiscrepancies.issue: AC Bypass wording differs between a heading and its explanatory choices.
sourceDiscrepancies.resolution: Use Always / Healthy / Never, also confirmed in the compact quick reference.

sourceDiscrepancies.issue: Custom-output prose initially says four gates but then describes gates 1–8 and draws eight.
sourceDiscrepancies.resolution: Map four OR and four AND gates; executable gate logic remains reference-only.

Test Display quick reference points to p110, but its body is on p114.
sourceDiscrepancies.resolution: The map cites printed p114 / PDF p116.

sourceDiscrepancies.issue: Later Auto-Set example selector is broader than the explicitly stated M800 capacity.
sourceDiscrepancies.resolution: Use the model-specific p39 capacity: eight M800 auto-sets, five time switches, thirty exceptions.

sourceDiscrepancies.issue: Manager Engineer Access names four windows and hotkeys 1–4, without showing the exact number-to-label mapping.
sourceDiscrepancies.resolution: Choices scroll by verified labels. No number assignment is invented.

coverage.countMeaning: Atlas entries include selectable values. They are not all separate screens. Repeated hardware instances are fixture records, not additional screen counts.
included: Zone type, attribute, ward and description sequence
Output families and source function catalogues
Power supply, input, fuse and network diagnostics
Manager tests, omission, users, logs and calendar timers

implementedBehaviors: Per-menu numeric navigation and arrows, plus physical ENT/ESC.
Zone record selection and immediate type → attributes → wards → description sequence.
ENT advance without synthetic writes when unchanged; ESC discards a draft and steps back.
Saved configuration values, per-record state, local fictional history and persistent state supported by the shared engine.
Deferred engineer commit and immediate accepted manager edits in separate roots.
M800 ordinary omission/reinstatement and documented ENT next-zone behavior.
Separate status and immediate resistance screens, fictional input activation, and log direction/details controls.
Numeric physical-output tests, automatic output stop on leaving the screen, local report preparation.
Independent older and later timer record scopes; exact model capacities where stated.
SHOW HINTS routes that only highlight physical buttons and stop before saving or executing an operation.
explicitSimplifications: There is no physical panel, radio, modem, ARC, downloader, printer or electrical connection.
Free-text entry uses a helper with ENT save and ESC cancel. The original multi-tap table is retained below for follow-up.
Unverified text, telephone, account and older timer/volume bounds are labelled as training bounds.
Output source catalogues are editable, but conditional wizard order, pulse duration and live gate/output logic are not a full firmware implementation.
The four detector fixtures retain their stated 4K7/2K2 readings when a different resistor configuration value is stored.
Manager Bell Test uses individual output toggles; Ward 1 walk testing has a fixed fixture and simplified result review.
Calendar exception/user allocations are consolidated masks; physical per-record No/Yes acceptance and actual timed execution are not reproduced.
The date helper combines day/month entry where the physical calendar prompt separates them.
No radio enrolment, NVM defaulting, credential defaulting or complex false-setting behavior is invented.
Numeric event filters, log offsets, remote network jumps and digital output bank switching are not implemented.

textKeysForFutureImplementation.documentedCursorRule: After choosing a character, up moves the cursor right and down moves it left; repeated presses cycle the current key’s table. No implicit timing timeout is asserted.
